description: Catalogue readiness inventory showing all 69 curated ATT&CK Enterprise techniques. Only the five genuine implemented detection mappings are enabled. All other entries are disabled and marked with their actual catalogue status. This is NOT a representation of implemented detection coverage. Parent roll-up techniques (T1110, T1059, T1204) remain disabled as independent detections. ATT&CK version v20.1.
